comment_auth: OCI Generative AI API key path. Export the key secret as OCI_GENAI_API_KEY on your own machine; never put it in this file or any chat.
comment_region: Region you stated. The API key must be in the same region as the model it calls. Base URL defaults to https://inference.generativeai.us-ashburn-1.oci.oraclecloud.com/openai/v1 (your article); set api_base_url to override.
comment_model: Replace with the exact model id your Ashburn account exposes. Oracle's availability table lists Llama 4 in Ashburn as dedicated-cluster only (on-demand is us-chicago-1), so confirm the model name before any paid call. Meta models are NOT supported on the Responses API; this runner uses /chat/completions only. The runner refuses any model whose price-list unit is not characters (Grok/gpt-oss are token-priced, dedicated endpoints are hourly) or that the token endpoint does not document - the char ledger cannot bound those.
comment_parallel: Start with at most two in-flight calls, shared one-second admission spacing. These are cautious pilot settings, NOT verified Oracle tenancy limits. A 429 delays all waiting workers and doubles spacing; successful replies do not speed it up. Increase only after measurement. The one-request smoke config stays serial.
comment_max_attempts: Owner-set REQUEST-COUNT bound, cumulative across runs. This is the enforceable pre-call bound: no Oracle doc states the billing metric of the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint, so the dollar estimate below is NOT a proven spend cap until a reconciled first call confirms the metric. Raise this only after that.
comment_billing: Oracle's price list meters on-demand Llama 4 Maverick/Scout per 10,000 transactions where 1 transaction = 1 character ($0.18 per 1M chars; pay-on-demand.htm: chat bills prompt+response chars). Whether THIS endpoint meters the same way is unconfirmed. Any other value here refuses the run, because the ledger's dollar gate only enforces char accounting.
comment_budget: Owner-set dollar budget, still enforced as a SECOND gate from the cumulative ledger; not a proven cap while the endpoint's billing metric is unverified (see max_attempts).
comment_price: Documented per-character list price for on-demand Llama 4; only allowlisted integer token counts are retained per attempt. They do not establish the billing unit or actual charge; reconcile against the tenancy billing source.
comment_cap: Per-attempt reservation ceiling: prompt bytes + overhead + 113 x max_tokens (= 115,712 at 1024 tokens). 120000 clears that at max_tokens 1024.
